title: viewer_desktop.show_lane_card
description: Raise the SpawnApproval card for a specific lane's spawn record (#305). Params: { number: integer (the lane's issue number, e.g. 219) }. The renderer matches the record by issue number / branch — the same matcher behind the clickable Lanes rows — and opens its card. Returns { ok, number, status } or { ok: false, number, error } when no record matches.
